thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service=infra-renderer (rule=nightly-ops-batch). Severity=high. Targets: devops-oncall, contractors-group. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC1765439999
PagerBot: page delivered to 7 recipients. Escalation policy=standard-oncall.
Jamie: got the page, odd — i'm not on infra-renderer rota tonight. seeing contractors in the list? :eyes:
Sasha: checking PD bindings now. can someone hold on ack until we confirm root cause?
Sasha: running quick lookup:
```
pd-cli service show infra-renderer --format json
# bindings:
# - schedule: infra-night
# - schedule: infra-night-shadow
# - escalation: devops-oncall
```
Sasha: yeah there's a duplicate binding: infra-night-shadow is a legacy schedule that routes to contractors. that explains the extra recipients.
Mohan: ugh that shadow schedule was supposed to be retired last month. looks like the service still has it attached.
Kim: if contractors are paged for production incidents that's a breach of policy. recommend removing infra-night-shadow binding immediately and mute contractors for the running incident.
Jamie: i'm +1 on removing but want ops-lead signoff. Priya, can you ack and take primary while we act?
Priya: acking and taking primary. Acked all pages. IncidentBot: Acknowledged by Priya.
Priya: i'm on it. Kim, what's the pd-cli command to remove the binding?
Kim: use this:
```
pd-cli binding remove --service infra-renderer --schedule infra-night-shadow --confirm
```
Kim: i'll stand by while someone runs it.
Sasha: i'll do it and post output. running now.
Sasha: (output) binding infra-night-shadow removed from infra-renderer ✅
PagerBot: binding removal event recorded in PD (event id: 8b3f2c). No further pages will be sent to infra-night-shadow.
Jamie: thanks. noise should stop. Priya: can you confirm contractor group has been notified not to respond?
Priya: pinged contractors channel and asked to ignore any further pages for infra-renderer. (reacts :white_check_mark:)
Mohan: checking alerts/metrics for customer impact. Initial graph: error rate spike at 03:14 -> 03:20 UTC, peaked 1.2% error rate, traces show 95% of failures were 503s from the renderer region while the fallback handled most traffic.
Mohan: small window, ~6 minutes of elevated errors. looks like routing flaps from failed retries after degraded instances. not directly caused by binding, but noisy pages made it look worse.
Jamie: customers: a subset of ingestion pipelines saw increased latency, about 0.8% of requests timed out. ops postmortem will have exact list.
Kim: immediate actions summary: 1) removed infra-night-shadow binding 2) muted contractor group for this incident 3) Priya acked and is primary 4) triage to confirm root cause of renderer errors (likely unrelated infra glitch)
Priya: opening a follow-up ticket now and assigning to Mohan + Kim. ticket: https://issues.example/IN-1765439999
Priya: scheduling 24h followup postmortem and assigning owner.
Sasha: low-effort prevention: add a validation job in our infra CI that flags services with >1 schedule binding or any binding that references a retired schedule. I'll draft a patch.
Mohan: agreed. also adding alert to flag sudden increase in PD recipients for a service (threshold: >3 unique schedules bound).
Jamie: for the immediate incident report i'll paste a short timeline:
- 03:13 UTC: infra-renderer alarms trigger, PagerDuty fires pages to infra-night and infra-night-shadow (shadow routes to contractors)
- 03:14 UTC: contractors and oncall receive pages; Priya acks and takes primary
- 03:15 UTC: Sasha removes infra-night-shadow binding (temporary mitigation)
- 03:20 UTC: error spike subsides, no further pages
- 03:30 UTC: follow-up ticket opened, postmortem scheduled
Kim: thanks all. small customer impact, noisy paging due to stale binding. action items tracked in IN-1765439999.
Priya: I'll write the initial incident summary for customers and ops channel. will ping when posted.
Jamie: huge +1 to Sasha for quick fix. can we avoid manual removals in future? automation task on Sasha's plate :) (reacts :thumbsup:)
IncidentBot: Note: incident resolved for paging storm. If further pages occur, re-open thread.
PagerBot: audit log: binding removal by Sasha at 03:15 UTC (audit id: a7c9e2).
Mohan: added preliminary notes to ticket, will dig into renderer error root cause tomorrow.
Priya: closing the noise, leaving follow-ups. thanks everyone.
